serverNotes: next.config.mjs sets output: "export": the site is exported as static HTML. Route handlers, cookies() and dynamic rendering are not available.

notes: Render <CopyEditing content={copy}> from refino/copy-editing.tsx around everything app/layout.tsx renders; pass no editing prop. Edit mode is decided in the browser from the Refino editor session, so the server never reads cookies and pages can stay static.

Refino hosts the copy API: the browser loads and saves through it with a short-lived editor token, and Refino commits to the repository through the Refino GitHub App. This deployment holds no editor password, no session secret, no repository token and no copy adapter, and needs no server functions; it works as a static export on any host.

Owners start editing at this site's /edit, which sends them to https://app.refino.dev to sign in; the site must be registered there with exactly this deployment's origin (scheme, host, port) or authorization is refused.
Owners sign in to Refino (GitHub) and Refino authorizes this site per request; the site has no login of its own.
